correctness.rationale: Endpoint coverage forces conjugate length-ell prefix/suffix and equal one-counts. If a≠c, equal one-counts leave only all-zero short factors (unable to cover ones) or ell≥b+max(a,c). With a=c, a<ell<a+b, the boundary r=ell-a one-runs cover the central b ones iff 2r≥b, giving ell0=a+ceil(b/2). The factors covering at long lengths are distinct conjugates containing all b ones; two special factors at shorter symmetric lengths. A cyclic-root partition cannot have >2 blocks with positive equal numbers of both symbols, so the only possible nontrivial root requires a=c and b even. Independently enumerated 100 triples with 1≤a,c≤5,2≤b≤5 from definitions; finite check is only corroboration.
